title: Follow the sweet aromas and long lines to Oakland’s latest buzzy bakery
blurb: Oakland bakery Studio Estepan, owned by Estevan Silva, offers Michelin-inspired, globally flavored pastries in a part‑time West Oakland shop.

title: In the heart of campus, a new hub opens for undergraduate education
blurb: New Undergraduate Academic Building opens this fall, joining Gateway, Moffitt Library, and Free Speech Movement Café on campus.

title: How to branch out from your major as a UC Berkeley student
blurb: UC Berkeley students can explore non‑major courses, enhancing skills and broadening perspectives across diverse academic disciplines.

title: Berkeley author maps out an ‘ecocivilization’ to avert climate and economic catastrophe
blurb: Author Jeremy Lent outlines an ecocivilization plan to avoid climate and economic collapse. (Sources: Farber’s “Reckonings,” LSD memoir.)

title: 2 UC Berkeley students create landscaping business within Berkeley tech bubble
blurb: Two UC Berkeley students launched a landscaping firm amid the university’s thriving startup environment.

title: Old Berkeley Lab building could become a data center, local communities raise concerns
blurb: Former Berkeley Lab office building in downtown Oakland may be converted into an AI data center, sparking local community concerns.

title: UC Berkeley analysis blames regressive state policies for high electricity bills
blurb: UC Berkeley study attributes over one‑third of California’s high electricity costs to state policies on wildfire prevention and solar development.

title: California’s billionaire tax proposition holds narrow lead as voters split along partisan lines
blurb: California’s Proposition 40, a billionaire tax, shows a narrow lead, with 48% of likely voters indicating support ahead of November.

title: Arson charge follows fire at Berkeley encampment
blurb: Arson charge filed after a fire at a Berkeley encampment; police allege Patrick Ford started the blaze over a scooter theft.

title: Couple is podcasting from a boat to preserve San Francisco Bay history
blurb: Mike Herz and wife Kate Josephs are podcasting from a boat, sharing San Francisco Bay history.

title: Green Day guitarist is obsessed with the hidden pathways of the Berkeley Hills
blurb: Green Day guitarist Jason White, a long-time Berkeley resident, plans to hike every path and staircase in the Berkeley Hills this year.

title: A popular SF Salvadoran restaurant, a Swiss chocolate shop and a new Mediterranean spot open in the East Bay
blurb: New restaurants in the East Bay include a Salvadoran eatery, a Swiss chocolate shop, and a Mediterranean spot, opening in Berkeley, Oakland, and Richmond.

title: Expanding what’s known about our fast-expanding universe
blurb: Saul Perlmutter reports his team's confirmation that the universe’s expansion is accelerating, adding new data on cosmic expansion.

title: Which Welcome Week character are you?
blurb: UC Berkeley's Welcome Week varies for newcomers, with some following scheduled, color‑coded itineraries and others unintentionally attending multiple events.

title: Summer’s not over yet, so make it count
blurb: Summer is ending; students urged to enjoy remaining days before school starts.

title: 6 finalists are interviewing for the open BUSD board seat. We surveyed them on the issues
blurb: Six candidates interview for BUSD board seat; survey covered special education, math readiness, after‑school care; directors may vote Wednesday.

title: ASUC hacked by phishing scam, campus office launches Phish Tank
blurb: Phishing scam compromised ASUC Communications email at UC Berkeley, leading to unauthorized messages and prompting campus office to launch Phish Tank.

title: UC Berkeley professor admits to using AI in op-ed calling out students’ lack of math proficiency
blurb: UC Berkeley math professor Zvezdelina Stankova admitted using AI to write an op‑ed in the San Francisco Standard, urging the UC system to reinstate standardized testing.

title: After intense competition, Berkeley Public Library announces 3 cute and cuddly mascots
blurb: Berkeley Public Library selects three new mascots after 108 applications, over 1,300 votes, and extensive deliberation.

title: It’s now easier for students to access CalFresh benefits
blurb: California Department of Social Services simplifies CalFresh for public university students, allowing them to bypass certain exemption requirements.

title: A move-in day conversation with UC Berkeley’s chancellor about student housing, protecting student rights
blurb: Chancellor Rich Lyons welcomed new students moving into campus dorms, discussing student housing and rights on move‑in day.

title: Man found deceased outside Rosa Parks during AM drop-off
blurb: Man found deceased outside Rosa Parks during AM drop‑off. Authorities identified him as 67‑year‑old Oscar Armando Medina of Berkeley.

title: Alameda County officials approve $1.5M for gender-affirming care, LGBTQ health
blurb: Alameda County Board of Supervisors approved $1.5 million for gender‑affirming and LGBTQ health services amid federal concerns.

title: After 34 years of debilitating sickle cell crises, CRISPR gave her a new chance at life
blurb: CRISPR therapy was first used on Victoria Gray, giving her a life after 34 years of debilitating sickle‑cell crises.

title: Burdell’s Geoff Davis is bringing back the neighborhood bar and grill
blurb: Geoff Davis opens new bar‑and‑grill, Uncle's, featuring wood‑fire cooking, unique steak cuts, and seasonal produce. He emphasizes it is not a steakhouse.

title: California Prop. 40, the ‘Billionaire Tax,’ holds lead in new UC Berkeley IGS Poll
blurb: California voters split on Prop. 40, the ‘Billionaire Tax,’ according to a new UC Berkeley IGS poll.

title: Judge imposes new conditions on Berkeley’s move to sweep Eighth and Harrison camp
blurb: A federal judge rejected a request to block Berkeley’s long‑term clearing of the Eighth and Harrison homeless camp, but imposed new conditions.

title: State Senate committee advances bill expanding on-campus jobs for undocumented students
blurb: California Senate Appropriations Committee voted to advance Assembly Bill 713, which would expand on‑campus employment for undocumented students.

title: UC Berkeley climate research center draws visit from Indian state delegation
blurb: UC Berkeley’s India Energy & Climate Center hosted a delegation from Telangana, including Deputy Chief Minister Mallu Bhatti Vikramarka, earlier this month.

title: Local Tibetan community mourns fallen activist, marches for cultural freedoms
blurb: Tibetan activists held a 200‑person candle vigil and march for Lobsang Palden’s freedom at Berkeley BART station.

title: Judge orders city to collaborate to accommodate disabled 8th and Harrison residents
blurb: Federal judge orders Berkeley and Berkeley Homeless Union to cooperate on accommodations for disabled residents near 8th and Harrison.
